notes: οὐκ and ἐδοκίμασαν form one aligned unit on 'refused', the single English word spelling negation and verb together (rule 39); rules 41 and 59 cannot empty the negator here because no second negative word stands.
'even as' stays whole on καθώς: the verse-initial καί is the connective rendered 'And', so no answering καί competes (rule 82).
τά takes 'those things' headed on the supplied nominal, the participle keeping 'which are … fitting' (rules 22, 102); the supplied possessive of anarthrous ἐπιγνώσει is a rule 7 helper on the noun.
